incidents.title: SonicWall SMA1000 appliances actively attacked; CVE-2026-83548 added to CISA KEV
incidents.what_happened: CISA added multiple actively exploited flaws to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog, including CVE-2026-83548 (an SSRF affecting SonicWall SMA1000 appliances); independent reporting indicates SMA1000 devices are under active attack.
incidents.why_it_matters: SMA1000 is a third-party VPN/remote-access appliance used by organizations; an unauthenticated, remotely exploitable flaw in these devices presents immediate compromise and lateral-movement risk for customers and downstream partners.
hot_fix: Identify and isolate internet-exposed SMA1000 appliances
Apply vendor patches or vendor-recommended mitigations immediately
Implement network-level protections and monitor for exploitation indicators listed by CISA

sources.name: The Hacker News - CISA KEV additions
The Register - SonicWall's SMA1000 boxes under active attack again

incidents.title: Public PoC released for 'FalconFlank' privilege-escalation in CrowdStrike Falcon sensor
incidents.what_happened: A security researcher published a public proof‑of‑concept called 'FalconFlank' that demonstrates a privilege escalation technique abusing CrowdStrike Falcon's remediation for malicious Office macros in the sensor.
incidents.why_it_matters: CrowdStrike Falcon is a widely deployed endpoint security agent; a working PoC enabling local privilege escalation against the sensor increases risk of endpoint compromise and potential disablement or evasion of detection across customer fleets.
hot_fix: Review CrowdStrike advisory and apply any available sensor updates or mitigations
Restrict local administrative privileges and harden sensor management controls
Monitor EDR telemetry for indicators of FalconFlank exploitation and suspicious privilege escalations

sources.name: The Register - PoC dropped for CrowdStrike Falcon exploit

incidents.title: Critical JFrog Artifactory flaw actively exploited to mint admin tokens
incidents.what_happened: An authentication-bypass vulnerability (CVE-2026-82329) in JFrog Artifactory is being exploited in the wild to create forged admin tokens that grant administrative access to exposed Artifactory servers.
incidents.why_it_matters: Compromised Artifactory instances can be used to modify, sign, or distribute malicious artifacts and affect downstream CI/CD pipelines and consumers of hosted packages.
hot_fix: Apply vendor security update/patch immediately
Revoke/rotate all Artifactory tokens and admin credentials
Conduct forensic review of artifact repositories and audit logs

incidents.title: SonicWall SMA1000 zero-days chained and exploited for unauthenticated RCE
incidents.what_happened: Two zero-day vulnerabilities impacting SonicWall SMA1000 appliances (including CVE identifiers reported by the vendor) are being chained and actively exploited to achieve unauthenticated remote code execution against internet-facing devices.
incidents.why_it_matters: Remote-access appliances are high-value targets; exploited SMA1000 devices can provide persistent network access and lateral-movement opportunities for threat actors across customer networks.
hot_fix: Apply SonicWall security updates and vendor mitigations immediately
Isolate or remove internet-exposed SMA1000 appliances until patched
Monitor for indicators of compromise and unusual admin/system activity

incidents.title: Sangoma Switchvox SQLi (CVE-2026-9586) exploited to deploy reverse shells
incidents.what_happened: An unauthenticated SQL injection in Sangoma Switchvox (CVE-2026-9586) is being actively exploited by attackers to achieve remote code execution and deploy reverse shells on affected VoIP appliances.
incidents.why_it_matters: VoIP platforms sit inside enterprise networks and can be used for persistent access, interception of communications, and lateral movement; affected appliances require immediate attention.
hot_fix: Apply Sangoma patches or vendor-provided mitigations immediately
Isolate affected Switchvox appliances from critical networks
Hunt for unauthorized shells, backdoors and suspicious outbound connections

incidents.title: Dropbox account takeovers tied to Lenovo email verification flaw
incidents.what_happened: Some Dropbox accounts were accessed after attackers exploited a flaw in Lenovo's email verification process to register fraudulent Lenovo IDs and use the legacy integration to access user accounts; reports indicate roughly 5,000 affected accounts in one report.
incidents.why_it_matters: Third-party identity-provider or legacy integration weaknesses can enable account takeover across customer bases; organizations relying on legacy SSO/integrations should assume risk to cloud storage and collaboration accounts.
hot_fix: Disable legacy Lenovo ID integration and force affected users to reset credentials
Require and enforce MFA for cloud storage accounts
Audit account access logs and look for unauthorized file access or sharing

incidents.title: BGP hijack diverted Softaculous/Virtualizor traffic, serving malicious updates
incidents.what_happened: Threat actors used a BGP hijack and a valid TLS certificate for Softaculous’ domains to divert traffic and serve a malicious Virtualizor update; hosting vendor advised customers to reset credentials and hunt for malicious packages after a prolonged diversion.
incidents.why_it_matters: Compromise of a software-distribution channel can deliver malicious code via trusted update mechanisms, impacting many downstream customers and hosted environments.
hot_fix: Rotate credentials and TLS certificates used by affected services
Validate package integrity and rebuild or isolate systems that received updates
Scan for and remove malicious packages; review supply-chain verification processes

incidents.title: UK bill amendments enable ministers to block high-risk tech suppliers from critical infrastructure
incidents.what_happened: Late amendments to the UK's Cyber Security and Resilience Bill would grant ministers new powers to restrict or block high-risk technology providers from supplying critical infrastructure.
incidents.why_it_matters: Procurement and third‑party-risk teams should reassess supplier exposure and contingency plans for suppliers that may be designated high-risk under the new powers.
hot_fix: Inventory suppliers providing technology to critical systems and map exposure
Engage legal/compliance on potential designation implications and timelines
Develop substitute/vendor-continuity plans for high-risk supplier scenarios

incidents.title: Critical JFrog Artifactory auth-bypass (CVE-2026-82329) exploited in the wild
incidents.what_happened: An authentication-bypass vulnerability in JFrog Artifactory (CVE-2026-82329) is being exploited days after disclosure, enabling attackers to mint administrative tokens and gain administrative access to exposed Artifactory instances.
incidents.why_it_matters: Compromised Artifactory servers can allow attackers to modify or publish malicious artifacts, issue admin tokens, and undermine CI/CD pipelines and downstream software supply chain integrity.
hot_fix: Isolate internet-exposed Artifactory instances
Apply JFrog vendor patch immediately
Rotate all Artifactory admin tokens/credentials and revoke suspicious tokens
Audit artifact repositories and CI/CD pipelines for unauthorized changes

incidents.title: Langflow RCE (CVE-2026-0768) exploited to steal OpenAI and AWS keys
incidents.what_happened: An unauthenticated remote code execution flaw in Langflow (CVE-2026-0768) is being actively exploited; attackers have used it to steal credentials, including OpenAI and AWS keys, from vulnerable deployments.
incidents.why_it_matters: Langflow is used to build AI applications; stolen API keys and cloud credentials enable attackers to access cloud resources, pivot to other systems, and contaminate AI workflows or data pipelines.
hot_fix: Upgrade Langflow to the patched release immediately
Rotate exposed API keys and cloud credentials
Hunt for indicators of compromise and unauthorized outbound activity

incidents.title: Aesto Health notifies breach impacting over 9.5 million individuals
incidents.what_happened: Aesto LLC (Aesto Health) disclosed a data breach that affected more than 9.5 million individuals after attackers accessed the company's AWS-hosted systems and exfiltrated personal and health information.
incidents.why_it_matters: A large third-party healthcare technology vendor breach poses regulatory, contractual, and operational risk to customers and partners that rely on the vendor for patient data handling and could require broad notification and remediation.
hot_fix: Engage legal and incident response; notify regulators as required
Confirm and secure all AWS access paths and rotate credentials
Assess scope of exposed data and notify affected parties per contracts

incidents.title: PaperCut zero-days exploited in active data-theft intrusions
incidents.what_happened: Two zero-day vulnerabilities in PaperCut NG/MF were patched after being observed exploited in data-theft intrusions; CISA added the issues to its KEV catalog.
incidents.why_it_matters: PaperCut is widely deployed for enterprise print management; active exploitation plus a CISA KEV listing creates immediate patching and supplier-continuity priorities for downstream customers.
hot_fix: Apply PaperCut emergency patches immediately
Isolate and harden print-management servers (network segmentation, restrict admin access)
Search logs/EDR for indicators of compromise and suspected data exfiltration

incidents.title: TerminalFix (ClickFix variant) uses fake Cloudflare CAPTCHAs to deploy reverse-tunnel backdoors
incidents.what_happened: A ClickFix variant dubbed TerminalFix is being used to present fake Cloudflare CAPTCHA prompts that trick victims into running malicious Windows Terminal/PowerShell commands, resulting in reverse-tunnel backdoors and remote access.
incidents.why_it_matters: Social-engineered commands executed in trusted shells increase the likelihood of persistent remote tunnels and lateral access; third-party web components and customer-facing sites can be leveraged to deliver these campaigns.
hot_fix: Block or sanitize suspicious CAPTCHA/script injections at web proxy/WAF
Restrict Windows Terminal/PowerShell execution via policy and application control
Monitor for unusual outbound reverse-tunnel connections and related IOCs

incidents.title: McKesson confirms data breach after ShinyHunters extortion claim
incidents.what_happened: McKesson confirmed a data breach following public extortion claims by the ShinyHunters group, which asserted theft of approximately 284 million records and issued a monetary demand.
incidents.why_it_matters: McKesson is a major healthcare supplier; a confirmed breach at this vendor creates broad downstream patient-data exposure, regulatory risk, and supply-chain continuity concerns for healthcare customers and partners.
hot_fix: Engage legal and incident-response; demand breach-impact and containment details from McKesson
Inventory downstream dependencies and exposed data types; notify affected stakeholders as required
Monitor criminal leak sites and credential marketplaces for stolen data tied to the vendor

incidents.title: FulcrumSec claims theft of 86 GB from Manchester Airports Group
incidents.what_happened: A threat actor (FulcrumSec) claims to have stolen 86 GB of passenger and booking data from Manchester Airports Group; independent validation of at least one traveller record and sample data was reported beyond MAG's initial disclosure.
incidents.why_it_matters: Exfiltration of customer travel and booking data raises regulatory, notification, and fraud risks for MAG and its downstream partners; procurement and TPRM teams should assume broader compromise until scope is confirmed.
hot_fix: Confirm breach scope with MAG/PSIRT and preserve evidence
Disconnect affected systems and collect forensic logs
Notify regulators and impacted customers per legal requirements
Search for lateral activity and indicators of compromise across partner integrations

incidents.title: Rhysida claims 5+ TB exfiltration from Berlin state network; city refuses to pay
incidents.what_happened: An extortion group (Rhysida) claims to have exfiltrated over 5 TB of data including personal information and credentials from Berlin's state administrative network; officials say they will not pay and forensic work found additional data outflows in a transport/environment department.
incidents.why_it_matters: Large-scale public-sector data exfiltration and extortion can trigger multi-agency response, regulatory obligations, and third-party risk for vendors and contractors handling municipal data.
hot_fix: Engage incident response and forensic services to validate claims and scope
Rotate credentials and secrets for affected systems and service accounts
Contain impacted systems, preserve evidence, and notify relevant agencies
Review vendor/third-party access logs and contracts for exposure

incidents.title: Hasbro discloses employee data breach
incidents.what_happened: Hasbro disclosed a cyberattack that allowed attackers to access personal and financial information for an undisclosed number of employees.
incidents.why_it_matters: Employee PII and financial data exposure creates regulatory, payroll-fraud, and insider-risk concerns for the company and its vendors; TPRM teams should assume supplier and partner touchpoints may require review.
hot_fix: Obtain Hasbro's incident statement and scope of systems/data impacted
Validate notifications to impacted employees and regulators
Assess whether vendor or third-party access was involved and review contracts
Increase monitoring for phishing/fraud targeting current/former employees

incidents.title: PaperCut NG/MF zero-day actively exploited; vendor issues second emergency patch
incidents.what_happened: PaperCut confirmed a zero-day in PaperCut NG and MF is being actively exploited; the vendor released emergency patches and followed with a second emergency update after researchers found bypasses to the initial fixes. PaperCut said it is aware of confirmed customer incidents.
incidents.why_it_matters: PaperCut is a widely deployed print-management product; active exploitation and multiple patch iterations increase risk of lateral access or code execution via a trusted vendor component, affecting many customers and downstream supply chains.
hot_fix: Apply PaperCut emergency patch immediately to all NG/MF instances
Isolate and audit PaperCut servers for indicators of compromise
Block internet access to PaperCut admin interfaces and enforce MFA

incidents.title: ServiceNow issues patches for three max-severity AI Platform flaws enabling code/SQL injection
incidents.what_happened: ServiceNow released security updates addressing multiple maximum-severity vulnerabilities in its AI Platform that could allow code injection, SQL injection, and privilege escalation; the company said it deployed updates to hosted instances and provided patches to partners and self-hosted customers.
incidents.why_it_matters: ServiceNow is a critical ITSM/automation vendor; unauthenticated exploitation could lead to service disruption, data access, or privilege escalation across customer deployments, requiring immediate patching and verification by TPRM teams.
hot_fix: Confirm ServiceNow hosted instances received vendor-deployed updates
Apply vendor-supplied patches to self-hosted instances immediately
Review ServiceNow audit logs for suspicious activity and unauthorized changes

incidents.title: Manchester Airports Group confirms data theft of customer records
incidents.what_happened: Manchester Airports Group disclosed a cyberattack in which attackers stole customer data, including Wi‑Fi sign-up records from Manchester, Stansted, and East Midlands airports; press reporting cites MAG and estimates up to 8.7 million customers may be affected.
incidents.why_it_matters: MAG is a major travel infrastructure provider; stolen customer data and potential downstream misuse can lead to regulatory, reputational, and operational impacts for partners and vendors that rely on passenger data.
hot_fix: Coordinate notification and credit-monitoring steps with MAG and affected partners
Search for MAG-related credentials in corporate SSO/credential stores and revoke if found
Review third-party integrations with MAG for exposed tokens or data feeds

incidents.title: ATF confirms 'major' cyber incident; DOJ investigating after ransomware group claim
incidents.what_happened: The Bureau of Alcohol, Tobacco, Firearms and Explosives (ATF) acknowledged a significant cyber incident and said it is investigating with the Department of Justice after a ransomware group claimed responsibility.
incidents.why_it_matters: A major US law-enforcement agency incident can have national security and continuity implications for vendors and contractors working with the ATF; it may trigger sensitive-data exposure and contract-specific breach obligations.
hot_fix: Review contractual notification and data-handling obligations for ATF-linked contracts
Enumerate and isolate any systems that exchange data with ATF networks
Monitor threat intel for claimed ransomware artifacts and Indicators of Compromise

incidents.title: Two alleged TeamPCP members arrested in Australia over supply-chain malware campaign
incidents.what_happened: Australian authorities arrested two men alleged to be members of TeamPCP, a group blamed for creating malicious open-source software used in widespread software supply chain attacks; reporting includes AFP involvement and investigative ties to long-running campaigns.
incidents.why_it_matters: TeamPCP is tied to prolific supply-chain compromises; arrests may disrupt threat actor operations but do not eliminate residual risk from backdoors or malicious packages already distributed to downstream consumers.
hot_fix: Audit internal use of open-source packages for unusual or unvetted modules
Hunt for indicators tied to known TeamPCP malware in software supply pipelines
Re-evaluate software procurement and OSS dependency controls
